svg.aria-label: Transcript RAG deploy topology: a visitor with no login reaches one App Runner instance of half a vCPU and one gigabyte, which answers every read route from a Chroma index and knowledge-graph snapshot baked into its own image; the deploy pulls that demo data from S3 into the image it pushes to ECR, which App Runner auto-deploys on the latest tag, and one CloudWatch alarm watches sustained 5xx.

g.title: visitor — no login, no account, no keys anywhere in the path
S3 demo bucket — the non-git working data the deploy syncs in: the Chroma index, the exported knowledge-graph snapshot, themes and conflicts
ECR — the linux/amd64 image with the corpus baked in; pushing :latest is the release step, App Runner auto-deploys it, and a 5-image lifecycle policy is the rollback window
App Runner — one instance, demo mode baked into the image, no VPC, no database, no provider keys; every non-GET is refused with 403
state — the Chroma chunk index and the graph snapshot ship inside the container, so the running service is read-only by construction; 539 MiB RSS measured at rest
CloudWatch — one alarm on sustained 5xx, the single failure mode worth waking up for on a portfolio demo

svg.text: ap-southeast-2 · Terraform · demo: no keys, no inference
